title: Syrian Chicken Kebabs
description: A kid-friendly Syrian dish featuring truffle oil and confit-tomato, this recipe is keto-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner. The funky and aerated texture of the kebabs makes it a fun meal for the whole family.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together truffle oil, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile, grill the confit-tomato for 2-3 minutes per side, until slightly charred.
Serve the kebabs with the grilled confit-tomato and a side of roasted vegetables.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
